programs.title: Naked and Afraid 6
programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.Operators show how people relying on their own company learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Africa Express
programs.desc:
For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship
Three pairs remain at the stadium in Sotik, and the competition changes the rules.Duos are split into chasers and players.Racers fight for survival: they look for transport, a place to sleep and face hunger.Players set out on a matatu with the leader, completing tasks whose results influence the fate of the chasers.Every mistake or success translates into difficulties or advantages for the partners.The first test is a quiz about the route so far, after which the chasers set off to Bomet, where they will face local challenges and convince a random passer-by to become their travel companion.During this time, players struggle with football tasks, fighting for further minutes of advantage.The final battle to get to the finals will be decided on the golf course at Sigona Golf Club.

programs.title: Passion - a way of life
programs.desc: The program shows the lives of extraordinary people who infect others with their inventiveness and courage.The protagonists of the documentary are both people involved in sports and people who found their vocation in unusual interests, including:designing and building miniatures or taking photos from the air.Viewers will learn, among others:Andrzej Bargiel, who became famous for skiing from the eight-thousander Broad Peak.Another hero of the program will be Sebastian Kawa, a glider pilot who has already won 15 gold medals in the World and European Championships.

programs.title: It's beautiful here
programs.desc: Dorota Szelągowska will visit unique places in Poland, the existence of which only insiders often know.The host will prove that it is never too late to fulfill your childhood dream and live in a tree house, at least for a while.For those who value greater comfort, he will show luxurious interiors created, among others, by:in an old cotton fabric factory.Viewers will also meet the owners of these charming places, who will tell their stories and reveal how they managed to implement their unique plans and projects.Many of them abandoned life in big cities to be able to do what they love most, i.e. interior design and running unique guesthouses.Dorota Szelągowska will look into every nook and cranny of these original buildings, reveal interior design ideas to viewers and prove that there are many wonderful places in Poland that are truly beautiful.
